checks.method: Rank from all exact permutation minors; independent largest-pivot Fraction Gauss-Jordan; original column bases, canonical free-variable kernel/left-kernel bases and augmented consistency, including rectangular and near-singular matrices.
Independent exact dot products and sequential multiplication, including rectangular composition, reflection, nilpotent/defective matrices, rational decay and zero exponent.
Independent shoelace area and composition order; exact inconsistent k=±4, consistent singular comparisons and accepted near-singular distant intersections.
All cube corners and oriented triple-product volume, rank-drop plane membership, complete 4D coordinates and rectangular kernel-family invariance.

Characteristic polynomial evaluations and exact nullspaces, identity/defective shear distinction, explicit complex quarter-turn eigenpairs, exact entire orbits and independent nonnormal closed form with n=2 versus n=3.

Independent exact cube-face-pair intersections recover all polygon vertices; plane residuals, convex ordering and common point/line/plane or empty classifications; orthonormal declared projection coordinates.
Invalid rational grammar, nonfinite values, declared magnitude/denominator bounds, ragged/oversized shapes, incompatible dimensions and unsupported spectrum/camera/iteration states rejected.

scope: Exact small rational matrices and declared fixture APIs. A bounded quarter-turn complex contrast is checked; no general numerical or complex eigensolver is claimed.
